user.title: Add a Freematics dongle
user.description: Name the dongle, usually after the car it's in. Home Assistant then makes a webhook for it and shows its address, which goes into the dongle's ESPHome config.

data_description.name: The device's name in Home Assistant, such as the car's.

reconfigure.title: Show the webhook address
reconfigure.description: Shows this dongle's webhook address again, and switches it to Home Assistant Cloud's address if you've subscribed since it was added.

create_entry.default:
Put this address in ESPHome Device Builder's Secrets under a name of its own (such as `car1_webhook_url`), and set the dongle's `ha_webhook_url` to that secret:

`{webhook_url}`

Keep it private: it's the dongle's only key. You can show it again with Reconfigure.

abort.no_https_url: The dongle needs an HTTPS address it can reach from the internet: subscribe to Home Assistant Cloud, or set an external HTTPS URL under Settings → System → Network.
abort.webhook_url:
This dongle's webhook address, for the secret its `ha_webhook_url` names in ESPHome Device Builder:

`{webhook_url}`
